task.title: Support ticket triage (77 banking intents)
task.business_story: A retail bank or fintech routes every incoming chat and email to the right queue or self-service answer by intent, for every customer message, all day. At that volume each call is cheap but the bill is not, so the smallest model that routes as well as the biggest one is the one you want.

FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=72,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
